---
title: Using advanced methods
jupyter: python3
---

In [Introduction to Python part 1](https://bristol-training.github.io/intro-python-1/) we saw different basic data types (integers, floats, booleans and strings), data structures called `list` and `dictionary`, and how to perform basic operations with it (indexing, slicing and adding elements).

Python provides several other powerful built-in data methods that allow you to work with complex data structures. In this section, we will see how to perform more advanced operations with strings and lists.
